hermes.native_install_note: Harbor's native Hermes adapter passes --branch v2026.9.24 to the moving main-branch installer URL. Harbor does not pass --commit or verify checkout HEAD. The resolved commit is upstream tag metadata, not an assertion about each runtime checkout.

model.route_policy: OpenRouter default routing for this model. Provider may vary between compatible endpoints

agent.max_turns_source: Harbor v0.23.0 native Hermes adapter hardcodes this config value and exposes no max_turns option
treatment_delivery: Harbor agent.skills registers the containing directory for Hermes discovery

cost.accounting: OpenRouter lifetime metadata before and after each slot; Harbor-reported cost is retained separately when present

task_toml:
schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "workpaperbench/{task_id}"
description = "Deterministic workpaper preparation and verification"
authors = []
keywords = ["accounting", "workpaper"]

[agent]
timeout_sec = 600.0
network_mode = "allowlist"
allowed_hosts = ["openrouter.ai"]

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 180.0
environment_mode = "separate"
network_mode = "no-network"

[environment]
build_timeout_sec = 900.0
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 4096
network_mode = "public"

[verifier.environment]
network_mode = "no-network"
